mapper.sql: o.ORDER_ID, o.ORDER_NO, o.CUSTOMER_ID, o.TOTAL_AMOUNT, o.STATUS, o.IS_DELETED, o.VERSION, o.CREATE_TIME, o.UPDATE_TIME, o.UPDATE_BY, c.CUST_NAME AS CUSTOMER_NAME, d.ITEM_NAME AS STATUS_NAME
FROM HOTEL_ORDER o LEFT JOIN CUSTOMER c ON o.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_DICT d ON d.TYPE_CODE = 'ORDER_STATUS' AND d.ITEM_VALUE = o.STATUS
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_HOTEL_ORDER.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO HOTEL_ORDER(ORDER_ID, ORDER_NO, CUSTOMER_ID, TOTAL_AMOUNT, STATUS, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY) VALUES(#{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{customerId}, #{totalAmount}0, #{status}1, F_NOW(), F_NOW(), #{updateBy})
mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(o.CREATE_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "day", COUNT(1) AS "orderCount", NVL(SUM(o.TOTAL_AMOUNT),0) AS "amount" FROM HOTEL_ORDER o WHERE o.IS_DELETED = 0 AND o.CREATE_TIME >= #{startDate} AND o.CREATE_TIME < #{endDate} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(o.CREATE_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY 1

-- 按房型统计：房费(ITEM_TYPE=1) 通过 SEGMENT_ID 关联到对应入住段， -- 直接聚合到该段所在房间的房型，不再按订单平均分摊。 SELECT rt.TYPE_NAME AS "typeName", COUNT(DISTINCT cr.RECORD_ID) AS "checkInCount", NVL(SUM(bi.AMOUNT), 0) AS "amount" FROM BILL_ITEM bi JOIN HOTEL_ORDER o ON bi.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID JOIN CHECK_IN_RECORD cr ON bi.SEGMENT_ID = cr.RECORD_ID JOIN ROOM r ON cr.ROOM_ID = r.ROOM_ID JOIN ROOM_TYPE rt ON r.TYPE_ID = rt.TYPE_ID WHERE o.IS_DELETED = 0 AND bi.IS_DELETED = 0 AND bi.ITEM_TYPE = 1 AND bi.SEGMENT_ID IS NOT NULL AND o.CREATE_TIME >= #{startDate} AND o.CREATE_TIME < #{endDate} GROUP BY rt.TYPE_NAME ORDER BY 3 DESC

-- 给定时间窗口内，所有入住记录按 [CHECK_IN, COALESCE(CHECK_OUT, F_NOW())] 与窗口求交集得到占用天数 SELECT NVL(SUM(GREATEST( LEAST(NVL(ci.CHECK_OUT, F_NOW()), #{endDate}) - GREATEST(ci.CHECK_IN, #{startDate}), 0)), 0) AS "occupiedDays" FROM CHECK_IN_RECORD ci WHERE ci.CHECK_IN < #{endDate} AND (ci.CHECK_OUT IS NULL OR ci.CHECK_OUT > #{startDate})
